valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Slower industrial/institutional volume, raw-material inflation, or CoolIT/Ovivo integration drag

base.driver: 5-7% organic sales growth, ~20% adjusted operating margin, and steady pricing

bull.driver: Upper-end 6-8% organic growth led by AI data-center cooling (CoolIT) and semiconductor ultrapure water (Ovivo)

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $9.45, the $309.27 close implies 32.7x; the pre-cutoff analyst sample (~$332 average) implies 35.1x at $9.45 EPS or $9.76 EPS at 34.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.45 (3.1 pp of upside at the $309.27 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Organic sales growth (5-7% target) and adjusted operating income margin progression toward 20%

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on 2026-10-27 ($2.18 adjusted EPS, FY2026 guidance $8.10-$8.20), UBS ($357), Wells Fargo ($315), and JPMorgan ($310) raised targets while Citigroup reiterated Buy ($345) prior to the 2026-11-13 cutoff. Subsequent post-cutoff target raises in mid-November 2026 following Investor Day (e.g., Stifel to $356, Mizuho to $350, Citigroup to $365, Wells Fargo to $380) are excluded from the pre-cutoff event timeline.
